notes.title: Update 1.60 - Season 6 is here!
notes.content:
Super Bit Machine is proud to present ARMAJET Update 1.60, Season 6! Out today, worldwide and on all platforms.

In this major update, we are ramping up the competition with a new game mode, mode-specific leaderboards, a new ultimate system, improved matchmaking, and way too much stuff to put in a single release :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33631841/04146cc5e921dfa75d105604e73b8e72a1005e70.png[/img]
[i]Starts June 21st, 2021
[/i]

[h1]NEW Game Mode: DUEL
[/h1]
It’s time to put your skills to the test, pilot! In Duel, only the best will taste victory. This new game mode is 100% skill – no compromises, no carrying, no bots to worry about. Since the beginning of Armajet we have focused primarily on team-based modes, but there’s often been demand for a place where talented pilots can shine on their own.

So, how does the new game mode work?

- Games are 1v1
- Health regeneration is turned off
- No ultimates
- Health pick-ups are 25 HP, and one will drop from a dead pilot
- Shield pickups are 25hp, and you can stack to 50
- First pilot to 5 kills wins!

We're excited to see videos of top competitions and see which loadouts are best for it. Also, picking a pilot with the right HP/Speed combination will be even more important here.



[h1]NEW Leaderboards
[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33631841/a14759ab4aeae130b4bfa4dc51dfe9fbd7b4d67f.png[/img]
[i]So much to choose from.
[/i]
In addition, to ramp up the competition even more, we’re introducing new and improved leaderboards, where we track Win/Loss ratios for each game mode, as well as Score, Top Wave and Time for Survival, broken down by solo, duo, trio and quad.

In Season 6, you’ll be able to compete against other pilots in a variety of categories. It will no longer only be about valor. We have added each game mode to the leaderboards for Versus categories, AND, there is also a new Survival leaderboard!

The feedback has been overwhelming that you love Survival. We do too, and that’s why we decided to add it to the new leaderboards. Now, you can see how great your Magma run stacks up to everyone else! Or maybe you’ll show off a crazy run on District? We’re excited to see!



[h1]NEW Matchmaking
[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33631841/d9e73ece8904e39a789f9cd24261aae28b8b7557.png[/img]
[i]Lots of options here, which default to all 8-player modes.
[/i]
In 1.60, you’ll be able to customize your ARMAJET experience exactly how you want it. Do you only want to play Deathmatch and Battle Ball? No problem! Fuel Frenzy and Deathmatch? You got it. And of course, the new game mode Duel.

The play mode screen now allows multiple selections. Remember: the more you select, the better and faster the matchmaking will be!



[h1]NEW Practice Mode
[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33631841/469cfabcb747711de6b4efe6a3d6da53682527f3.png[/img]
[i]Rip 'em a new one in practice mode
[/i]
With this new mode, you’ll be able to try out any weapon, secondary and ultimate before you decide to unlock it. Pressing “Try Now” will take you to a special map where immobile bots will spawn and you can freely try out anything in the Armory!



[h1]NEW Tiered Ultimate System
[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33631841/6555499cf1ad100d738cd1189a0858d4fe8d6a4c.png[/img]
[i]Well, what do we have here...
[/i]
One of the ways we’ve wanted to expand ARMAJET is by introducing bigger and more powerful Ultimates. However, in the current system, we’re limited because they would swing the game too much and make the game feel less skillful and controlled, and more chaotic instead. In order to bring those kinds of Ultimates, we need to increase the risk and reward while maintaining an aspect of skill. To accomplish that, we’ve created a new 3-tier Ultimate System!

Here’s how it works:

Each kill you accumulate will charge your Ultimate by 1. Each tier requires 3 kills in order to fully charge. It is up to you if you want to wait for the next tier, OR, use the tier that is available to you. As you progress up each tier, the Ultimates get more and more powerful, until you reach Tier 3 where a Napalm Strike will almost definitely wipe out the other team!

To choose which Ultimates you’d like to use, access your Armory and select an Ultimate in each Tier (I, II and III). If you’ve successfully selected an Ultimate, its icon will show up on your Armory screen above the respective tier.

We believe this will make Loadouts more flexible, and will give new meaning to a "life" in ARMAJET. You can still do rush, die, repeat, but there's a clear advantage if you can stick around and survive.

Because of this change, we've modified most maps to have an Ultimate charge. Picking up an Ultimate charge will immediately take you to the next tier!

Note: If you see a player with a head streak (the colored fire sticking out of players' heads) it means they can unleash a streak, so watch out!



[h1]NEW Secondary Weapon: the Looper boomerang
[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33631841/32ae5d0d5ba9c755eebfdb717cabfc57f56da141.png[/img]
[i]It will come back to haunt you
[/i]
Introducing our latest creation to assist your K/D on the new leaderboards: Looper – a boomerang!

Looper is a projectile that can pierce enemies (similar to Velocitas) and deal damage to multiple pilots in one shot. At 35 damage per hit, that adds up pretty quick! Like a real boomerang, when you throw it, it will attempt to return to you before it disappears. This means you can hit the same enemy twice dealing up to 70hp worth of damage!

We can’t wait to see what kind of trick shots and interesting ways pilots will make use of this new weapon! As a hint, try throwing it through the teleporters in Laboratory!

Looper is available as an exclusive for Season 6 in the season pass, and after Season 6 it will be available to unlock in the Armory.

[h1]NEW and Improved Laboratory Map
[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33631841/54a4be828c14b580b1ce33ceb99eb3d9a47735de.png[/img]
[i]Tighter, but still teleport-y
[/i]
When we released Laboratory, we wanted to try something new and different – teleporting. As well, we wanted to make a map unlike any other in the game in terms of size and feel. However, after thorough testing and from your feedback, it was clear that the large size of the map didn’t suit the way ARMAJET is designed.

In this redesign, we kept the tactical feel of the large map, but shrunk it down and tightened up the middle. Laboratory now feels much more accessible while giving you similar ways to move around the map.


A bunch of other changes and fixes have been bundled with this release, including:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33631841/0a2c6dd5583b3e3b5b4d9aa8c0453237a590e49d.png[/img]
[i]Arrrrrriving with the Season Pass
[/i]
- Season 6 "Plunder" weapon skins
- New in-game decals (explosions and blood), which you can turn on/off in settings
- New survival systems and balancing (enemies have to walk into base to damage it instead of firing at it)
- Improvements to Drone AI
- More customization options for Custom games (time/goal limits)


We hope you enjoy this release, and remember: we listen to ALL the feedback we're getting, including:

- The emails you send us at support@superbitmachine.com
- The messages on Discord
- The reviews on the AppStore, GooglePlay store and Steam
- Your comments on Twitter
- Your big juicy feedback posts here on Reddit!


Thanks for playing and see you in the skies, Pilots!

notes.title: Update 1.59 - "Sun's out, Guns out" Season 5 is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33631841/ed55d780a43cfc147d0938e379336eed65846058.png[/img]


[h1]NEW MAP! - Beach
[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33631841/d0cd06d01665edd7ef3b74096c2c8ca1a2759dca.png[/img]

As good weather begins to approach, we were really feeling those summer time vibes and thought, what better theme for our Season 5 map, than to hit the beach with a blacktusk, soak up some sun rays and blast some buddies? Our new map features an oceanside view with caves to explore and a nice hot sandy beach perfect for playing some Beach Battle Ball!


[h1]NEW ULTIMATE! - Reflector EXO
[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33631841/d43298faf8f6a534bea8af54e17effd528fb688c.png[/img]

Another excellent community-generated idea (thank you Hoakin Blackforge!), we bring you a new tool to further your arsenal of options to mow down your opponents - the Reflector EXO!

Here’s how it works:

After activating, you will receive 33% less damage. Every time you are dealt 50 damage (based on the damage before damage reduction is applied), Reflector fires that damage back towards your opponent! It lasts for 20 seconds so you’ve got plenty of time to make use of it. But keep in mind, while 33% less damage sounds like a lot, you can still die easily if you’re not careful!


[h1]NEW SKINS! - The Pineapple series
[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33631841/2e6512adac44a0054eb5cc674a887467efc0cd8b.png[/img]

New Pineapple death effect and skin for: Cluster Grenade, Nightfall, Prox. Mine, Venom, Locust, Ripper and Tremor!

[h1]NEW MOVEMENT AND PHYSICS FOR SEASON 5![/h1]

That’s right, we have made some big, bold changes to the way movement and physics work in Season 5! Get strapped in because the changes are pretty significant!

- Ground speed has been increased - you will run 10% faster now. This is a huge change - it means your top speed on the ground is higher, just by running.
- Running and flying acceleration is doubled. Top speeds will take much less time to reach. This will increase responsiveness a lot, especially when moving left/right repeatedly.
- Jetpack thrust has been improved greatly. When you start to use your jetpack, it will consume 5 frames of fuel in 1 frame, while providing a lot more movement. This decreases the time you’re lagging mid-air and increases responsiveness of the controls, especially mobile devices.
- Ground hopping (aka bunny hopping) gives more horizontal momentum than before, so you will achieve top speeds faster moving horizontally.
- Boost has been adjusted to have more mid-air acceleration, making it better at being a dodge ability as opposed to reaching top speeds.

Why did we make changes to movement for Season 5, you might ask? During internal testing, we found that when you improved responsiveness, movement felt a lot better. Players want immediate feedback when they make inputs, so for Season 5 we want to make that better in every area - on the ground, in the air, when you’re running, etc. Additionally, we are positioning bunny hopping to be the king for reaching top speeds, as opposed to using boosts. Overall, we think you’ll find the changes make Armajet feel much snappier than before.


[h1]General Changes and Bug Fixes
[/h1]A bug that prevented players from being able to queue using specific game modes has been fixed (Note: We are also aware that there is a bug similar to this affecting Quick Play. This may have fixed both - please let us know if you continue to experience getting stuck in queue when using Quick Play by sending an e-mail to support@superbitmachine.com!)

- Fixed a bug where you can't change the clan tag and in some languages, can't create a clan
- A bug related to “Please Wait…” issues when opening packs has been fixed
- Fixed issues where auto-aim would not lock onto new enemies while holding down, or give a highly inaccurate angle until released
- Fixed issue sometimes disconnecting users that were both connected with wifi and cellular at the same time and had spotty wifi
- Implemented adaptive input queue to reduce rubber banding and improve stability for jittery connections
- Added network monitor (beta) which you can activate from Settings (if you have connection trouble, send us a video with it showing!)
- Laboratory: Projectiles now teleport correctly


[h1]Balance Changes
[/h1]

[h3]Nightfall
[/h3]
- Damage 100 -> 110
- Projectile size and trail is now easier to see
- Can no longer fire when charge is at less than 100% (like Velocitas)
[i]Nightfall is meant to be a high risk, high reward weapon and this will give it back that threatening, one-shot power it used to have.
[/i]

[h3]Locust
[/h3]
- Damage 14 -> 13
[i]Locust had a bit too much front-loaded damage, making it too strong combined with its excellent pushback capability.
[/i]

[h3]Ripper[/h3]
- Damage 50 -> 40

[i]This will help balance Ripper’s through-wall effect which has proven to be very effective.
[/i]

[h3]Frag Grenade
[/h3]
- Range 19.5m -> 16.5m
[i]This will make Frag a little more risky to use, balancing its high payload.
[/i]

[h3]Proximity Mine
[/h3]
- Damage 90 -> 100
[i]Proximity mine’s payload wasn’t good enough to warrant running it instead of a more situational secondary. This damage boost should make it a viable support tool. As a hint - think jump pads!
[/i]

[h3]Vector
[/h3]
- Damage 90 -> 70
[i]After seeing how well players have been able to make use of Vector’s bounce, we can tune its damage down to a more reasonable level.
[/i]

[h3]Gun Sentry
[/h3]
- Damage 12 -> 11
[i]Gun Sentry is a stationary Blacktusk, so this brings them back to parity.
[/i]


Thank you to the community for all of your excellent and creative ideas. They continue to be a driving force for new and interesting additions to our game. We always love to hear what you think about Armajet and if you think you have a great concept for something, like a new weapon or a map, or anything really, put your idea here on Reddit and we will be happy to take a look at it!

We can't wait for you to try all of the new content and changes in this jam-packed update. Be sure to let us know what you think of the update when it drops here on Reddit or over on our Discord server (https://discord.gg/armajet)! Thanks for playing Armajet and see you in the skies, Pilots!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.13: **ARMAJET FULL CONTROLLER SUPPORT**
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33631841/676e0091878b64aa43994965ed9d27ec3c6fc398.jpg[/img]

Update 1.13 brings one of the most requested features of all-time: FULL cross-platform controller support! Take control of how you want to play on iOS, Android and Steam (PC/Mac) by using any of today's most popular controllers (see the full compatibility list below).

Get your screenshots ready and claim 'MVP' status of your team in the new Squad Showcase during the end of round sequence! And don't forget to take our newest pilot, Ruthless, on a rampage—now available in packs!

If you're enjoying Armajet, remember to please leave us a review!

Update 1.13 is expected to land on ALL App Stores on Monday, March 23rd, 2020 -- stay tuned!

—

[h3]FULL CROSS-PLATFORM CONTROLLER SUPPORT[/h3]
Armajet is now compatible with the most popular controllers per platform with a growing list of unofficial (but supported) controllers updated frequently. Check out the official list below and refer to in-game Settings for the default static mapped buttons per controller.
[list][*] Windows PC: Xbox One, PS4, Razer Raiju Mobile, Razer Wolverine -Steam
[*] Mac OS: PS4
[*] Android: Xbox One, PS4, Razer Raiju Mobile (wired and wireless), Razer Junglecat
[*] iPhone / iPad (iOS 13+): Xbox One, PS4
[/list]
Unofficial controller support, but working:-Nintendo Switch Pro Controller (PC/Android)-Steel Series Stratus Controller (Android, Razer Phone, Samsung S9)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33631841/4ab09cf58b2edbe959e9f833a3dcdaa15a52fd50.png[/img]

[i]SBM Commentary: It's been a hot minute since you've all asked for controller support and we're incredibly happy to roll this out for all platforms in 1.13! No more screen-mapping or non-seamless switching between Mouse-Keyboard-Controller... play as you want and keep your controller attached like they should be. Rebinding isn't in yet, but feel free to let us know as a community if you need to see a static binding update![/i]

[h3]SQUAD SHOWCASE WITH PILOT MVPs[/h3][list][*] Be the Most Valuable Player of the squad during the UI-free end of round sequence! Take a screenshot of your squad during the post-game with 1st through 4th place FFA rankings by kills and MVP highlights by score in every other game mode
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33631841/d7aefde8a94386dedc178dc0bd5bfabc2cff21f3.png[/img]

[h3]NEW DYNAMIC NEWS FEED[/h3]
Our in-game newsfeed is now capable of featuring our amazing content creators, competitive community tournaments, and in-game events!
[list][*]Real-time updating of in-game newsfeed with link that takes you straight to the information (or livestream, VOD, meme... you name it!)
[*]Armajet Newsfeed now includes the official Armajet Discord and Twitter links
[*]Any new News will refresh the newsfeed with a red "!" indicator so don't miss out on any events if you see a new notification!
[/list]
[i]SBM Commentary: We admire and appreciate our content creator and tournament organizer communities for their amazing livestreams, VODs, competitive events and handsome memes! This feature goes out to the Pilots who would love to gain more visibility right through our game. We'll mix up your content alongside our official patch notes, in-game events, and upcoming leeks! Our content creator guidelines will absolutely change as in-game featuring will be available for community members who can provide positive, meaningful content to Pilots eager to learn more about Armajet. Join us on Discord to inquire about being an Armajet Content Creator.[/i]

[h3]1.13 WEAPON BALANCE UPDATE[/h3]
Check out these HUGE balance changes just in time for Update 1.13 and many of you have these listed as your favorites! We're excited to see what you'll do with them in upcoming competitive events and public matches in general... especially as most of these are buffs and mechanical changes!

[b]PRIMARY WEAPONS[/b]

[b]Venom (Overall Buff)[/b]
[list][*]Now with more goo! 3 Goobabies now deal 8dmg each (up from 2 Goobabies dealing 10dmg each)
[*]Direct 'Goo' damage increased to 25 (up from 20)
[*]Increased burst interval by ~28%
[/list]
[b]Leviathan (Overall Buff)[/b]
[list][*] NEW Incendiary Rounds on contact dealing 2 ticks of 8 dmg each (total 16) on top of the 70dmg direct bullet (down from 80) = Total of 86 dmg if hit!
[*] Increased weight and cooldown per shot by 10% (cooldown to 2.2s per shot from 2.0s)
[/list]
[b]Lycan (Overall Buff)[/b]
[list][*]Clip size increased to 10 from 6
[*]Faster burst interval by 25% (.3s from .4s)
[*]Knockback removed
[/list]
[b]Havoc (Slight Nerf)[/b]
[list][*]Increased cooldown to match Badger (1.8 up from 1.6s)
[/list]
[b]Ripper (Major Rework and Overall Buff)[/b]
[list][*]Ripper Blades have been sharpened and now fly faster, longer and with more bounce!
[*]Reduced damage per blade to 12dmg (down from 35) but...
[*]Increased Clip Size to 10 (from 3)
[*]Burst and Cooldown reduced by 50% (.5s to .25s, respectively)
[*]Slight range reduction (~6%)
[*]Knockback reduced by 50% (2 from 4)
[/list]
[i]SBM Commentary: Not sure which one of these buffs are your favorite? Good news! You'll be able to earn a majority of these weapons just by playing Armajet and progressing through Valor Road![/i]

[h3]ULTIMATES[/h3]
Drones in general receive a slight buff with increased Speed!
[list][*]Up to 20 Speed from 16
[*]Up to 10 Acceleration from 7
[/list]
[i]SBM Commentary: Since the 'EXO' update, we didn't want our lovely drones of death lagging behind the curve. They should be speedier as we look into other ways to balance Ultimates in the future.[/i]

---

Phantom lovers, we haven't forgotten about you! We're taking a deep breath after the above changes and will see what we can do to make Phantom a bit more fun.

[h3]INVITE FRIENDS FOR PARAGON REWARDS[/h3][list][*] Get rewarded for inviting NEW players to Armajet—invite three friends for 200 Paragon and Buster Pack rewards! Note: Only new device installs count with your friend code (Hit 'Invite' in the Social Screen to copy your link)
[/list]

[h3]VALOR ROAD OVERHAUL[/h3][list][*] Major adjustments including currency, packs, new weapon rewards and more!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33631841/38bb0db46d4be1b0aeeb055b8402818fdb6f7459.png[/img]
[i]SBM Commentary: After listening to even more feedback on player rewards, Valor Road has no received a big buff! Currencies including Gold and Paragon checkpoints now reward larger amounts both below <5K and >5K Valor. 5000 Valor will be an important marker in the coming future as we explore Season resets. Exclusive weapon items of different rarities and types have been moved to Valor Road in hopes that players can explore even more playstyles. Reminder: Only SKILL can get you there—increasing weapon rarities only lead to MORE SITUATIONAL gameplay—TEAM UP with more Pilots to claim all the items through 5000 Valor![/i]

[h3]GENERAL UPDATES[/h3][list][*]QoL Home Screen UI Update: Pilot Profile and Valor Road Progress have been split up for greater clarity and access to specific notifications
[*]Various network and cellular data updates
[/list]

---

[i]We're hoping Update 1.13 gives all of our current and future pilots the MOST accessibility and control options to date and highlights our goal to bringing more parity on all platforms! Don't forget to share Armajet with friends that have been waiting for these features and, as always, we'll see you in the skies!

-Super Bit Machine[/i]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.12: CHALLENGES, FFA, and MUTATORS!
notes.content:

Pilots, get ready for Daily and Weekly rewards with Challenges! Fight in our skies every day to claim currency, pack rewards, and more in the most feature-packed Armajet update ever! Flying solo? Test your skills among your fellow pilots in the new Free For All game mode!

Play Armajet with a few deadly twists! Introducing Game Mode Mutators including 'Instagib', 'High Octane', 'Transfusion' and more. Unlock and learn about Mutators through Valor Road. Try them out in our all-new cyberpunk-themed arena, District, a glimpse into the future of Armajet!

If you're enjoying Armajet, please leave us a review!

[i]SBM Commentary: We are SO excited to see what our Pilots think of the largest game content drop (so far) since worldwide release! There's so much airspace to cover in these Update 1.12 release notes that we'll be sharing (leeking?) some snapshots alongside 1.12's most important features: Challenges, Free For All, and Game Mode Mutators! Stay tuned this week for the word when 1.12 drops and dig in below![/i]

---
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33631841/bc50ae04d7c47d2f030305fed8304d0326d24f57.jpg[/img]
[h3]Challenges[/h3][list][*] Test your skills by completing Daily and Weekly Challenges with currency and pack rewards
[*] Claim completed Challenge rewards in the home screen and quickly check progress in-game during weapon loadout selection
[*] Squad up with friends to complete more difficult or game-mode specific Challenges
[/list]
[i]SBM Commentary: We've always wanted to give our Pilots more ways to gain rewards especially as we forge ahead with Seasonal development and future progression systems linked to even more in-game content. Challenges resolve the overwhelming requests by our community for more currency rewards for Weapons, Pilots, and Jet Trails unlocks in the Store. Have fun with these and don't forget to WORK TOGETHER to complete some of the tougher ones![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33631841/699d59c219fb3f1aae28a0e21298472160965e83.jpg[/img]
[h3]Game Mode: Free For All[/h3][list][*] It's every Pilot for themselves in the classic Free For All (FFA) mode and only the Top 50% of Pilots will be victorious
[*] New FFA scoreboard indicating Top 50% (tagged in Gold) and your placement (Alpha) relative to everyone else (Bravo)
[*] FFA is available to vote on and play in all arenas including Custom Matches
[/list]
[i]SBM Commentary: There's nothing wrong with flying solo in our skies! For those who've ever wanted to shoot anything that moves... Free For All game mode has arrived! Test your flight skills against everyone in the arena and claim a top 50% spot to secure the W... err V (for Valor). Good luck in discovering which weapon combinations work for you![/i]
[h3]Korean Language Support[/h3][list][*] 하늘에서 보자, 조종사!
[*] Korean language support now available and ready to select from in Language Picker (Settings, Account)
[/list]

We've seen some of the tournaments our community has been producing lately and we're excited to see what can happen with Armajet streams or competitive events with even more options and Mutators available to use. If you're looking to produce tournaments, give us a shout in our discord as we'll happily support these events![/i]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.10 **BATTLE BALL and SQUAD CHAT!**
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33631841/dc668c4dbc74d9ad28c1d1357670b254fdbabdcb.jpg[/img]
Introducing our newest game mode: BATTLE BALL! Work together with your squad to score 3 goals into the enemy power hoop to win! Shoot, Pass, and Dunk the Battle Ball to cause killer chain reactions!

SQUAD CHAT is now available in the home screen lobby! Look forward to discussing strategies with your squad between games.

If you're enjoying Armajet, please leave us a review!

----

[i]SBM Commentary: Arriving just in time for Bitmas 2019... Battle Ball is here in our biggest update yet! With a game mode like this, pairing it up with Squad Chat is critical to your team's success. We encourage all of you Pilots to discover new competitive strategies in all our current arenas! Remember, team work is everything in this mode... don't forget to Pass, Shoot (from far away if you're good enough!) and Dunk the Battle Ball! Do you know a goalie with a golden glove? Guard that goal carefully and see you in the arena![/i]

[h3]Battle Ball![/h3]
- Play Battle Ball, our newest strategic game mode, in 3v3 or 4v4 Squads!
- Work together closely to Shoot, Pass, Intercept and even Dunk the Battle Ball (if you dare!)  
 - Use each map's unique terrain for tricky 'bounce' and 'bank' skill shots
- Each team's power hoop is located on opposite ends of each map—defend them wisely! (No, you can't score in your own goal!)
- Picking up the Battle Ball instantly replaces your secondary and functions similarly to a frag grenade (Hold-Release; longer Hold for maximum range and throw velocity)
- Score 3 Goals OR have the most goals in 3 minutes to win!  
 - Tied scores initiate a one minute overtime!
- Dropping the Battle Ball for more than 5s destabilizes its core causing a massively deadly explosion!
- The Battle Ball respawns in 10s after every Goal or Battle Ball explosion
- NEW Battle Ball Visual and Sound FX!
[i]SBM Commentary: The Battle Ball can pass through vines and light bridges on Temple, Moon and Snow Base and we CERTAINLY had an explosive time trying some of these strats! Pro Tip: The Battle Ball remembers "last touch" characteristics, so if you're going for the dunk and get blown to bits in the right direction you may yet score a GOOOAL![/i]

[h3]Squad Chat[/h3]
- Start a Squad Chat by creating a squad or joining another Pilot's squad in the home screen!  
 - Squad Chat channel and alerts appear in the home screen (upper left!)
- Squad Chat history is preserved with time stamp information (as long as the squad exists)
- Use Emojis with Squad Chat!
SBM Commentary: Squad Chat is finally here! We encourage all of our Pilots to socialize and form strategies between games, especially as we develop even more competitive game modes!

[h3]Feature Updates[/h3]
- NEW Ball Cam! Spectators can follow the action and lock in on the Battle Ball "Ball Cam"
- NEW Battle Ball Game Mode in-game XP to count towards Ultimate charge
- NEW "Per Mode" Scoreboards that contain specific information for Team Deathmatch, Fuel Frenzy, Battle Ball and future game modes!
- NEW XP Bonuses towards leveling up your Pilots!  
 - First Win of the Day
 - Squad Bonus
- Create your own Battle Ball matches and tournaments in Custom Matches
- Emojis are now available to use at the End of Round screen
- (Mobile) New "How to Play" static tutorial during boot-up and home screen
- Additional language support for German, French and Italian (more options and languages coming soon)
- Improved and polished various Map and Pilot Visual FX

[i]SBM Commentary: We have SO MUCH MORE in store for Bitmas so stay tuned for special announcements, events, and incredible stocking stuffers from all of us at Super Bit Machine. Thank YOU so much and Happy Holidays![/i]

Join our community on discord.gg/armajet or reddit.com/r/armajet for more detailed release information.

notes.content:

Armajet now also includes language support for Russian, Spanish and Portuguese with even more international languages coming soon. And finally, Custom HUD and more control options arrive for our mobile-only Pilots!

If you're enjoying Armajet, please don't forget to leave us a review and join us on discord.gg/armajet for more information!

[h1]Feature Updates[/h1][list][*] Laugh, Cry, Smooch, Angry, Sweaty and say 'GG' with new animated gif emojis! These replace the default lineup of static emojis and are bindable on Armajet PC
[*] Armajet is now localized to Russian, Spanish and Portuguese with even more international language support coming soon
[*] Valor Road Updates: Unlock the Super Shield Ultimate, exclusive SBM Jet Trail, and EMP Grenade at 500 valor, 650 Valor and 800 Valor
[*] Improved and polished various UI elements
[*] Improved and polished various explosion VFX
[*] Equip the exclusive Fall 2019 Seasonal Badge[/list]
[i]SBM Commentary: Share how you feel in the middle of a match as quickly as possible with these new animated emojis! We're also rolling out 1.9 with our first trio of localized language support which should help our international friends understand our UI elements and Settings, especially now that they're customizable! To round off 1.9, we've tweaked Valor Road under 1000 to include even more early-game countermeasures as your progress through your Pilot Career—Super Shield and EMP are high-tier weapons and now they're available to support you through your journey past 1000 Valor! Note: If you have yet to unlock Super Shield and EMP Grenade but are over Valor 1000, check your armory shortly after 1.9 drops![/i]

[h1]Overall Gameplay Improvements[/h1]Jetpack power has been increased when falling. Pilots can now stop downward momentum and reach ledges without depleting all of your fuel—try more advanced moves to increase your flight time!
[i]SBM Commentary: Have you ever dropped down from the sky, activated your jetpack expecting positive lift... and completely used up all your fuel reaching a ledge? Not anymore, Pilots! Check out the new jetpack with increased feedback (this change also enables some great air-braking/juking tactics...)[/i]

[h1]Weapon Balancing[/h1]Ultimate charge rates now consider ALL sources of score-additive XP gain, including Killstreaks and Medals (previously Kills and Assists only) along with the standard charge rate of +3 "XP" per second
[list][*] Pilots holding Fuel Cells in Fuel Frenzy now gain +25XP per cell held every 20s (which also contribute to Ultimate charge)
[*] EXO Ultimate cooldowns are reset upon death, enabling them to re-charge much quicker
[*] All mechanical Ultimates (Sentries & Drones) now delay firing until fully spawned
[*] (+) Shock Drone damage now matches Thunderstorm damage (8 damage)
[*] In order of quickest Ultimate charge and frequency, EXOs are now generally easier to charge, then Rocket Strike, Sentries and Drones, followed by the Flame Drone and Napalm Strike[/list]
[i]SBM Commentary: Ultimates now charge with ALL XP sources achieved during gameplay, including Killstreaks, Medals, and Fuel Frenzy cells held (alongside Kills and Assists). Hint: If you're confident in your killing spree abilities, harder-to-obtain and riskier Ultimates should be well within your wheel house. Conversely, if you play more of a support or backline role, EXO suits are generally easier to obtain for you.[/i]

[h1]Custom HUD and Aim Assist Options[/h1]Mobile players are now able to customize and save placement of movement and firing areas, movement stick, Primary and Secondary sticks, Ultimate and Boost button
[list][*] Aim Assist is now optional with "ON" (default) = Classic Aim Assist with tap-to-fire and "OFF" = 'Deadzone' introduced with drag-to-fire mechanic

[/list][i]SBM Commentary: One of the most anticipated features finally comes to mobile: Custom HUD! Adjust your button layouts to be more ergonomic across all mobile devices. Secondarily, more advanced aiming is possible with Aim Assist = OFF, activating a deadzone for manual fire! Veterans and starting Pilots can both appreciate more control and customization options and we're happy to continue improving "V1" as we seek to bring even further button parity across platform.

See you in the skies, Pilots![/i]

With the launch of Fuel Frenzy, we've also revamped each game mode's "intro card" animation to make sure you know exactly which game mode you're joining and spectating. Check out the rules and additional in-game features built specifically around Fuel Frenzy below!

[h1]**Update 1.6X Official Release Notes**[/h1]
[i]Please read these thoroughly, including the KNOWN-ISSUES which will be updated ASAP.[/i]

[b]FUEL FRENZY![/b]
[list]
[*]Capture and hold 10 or more Fuel Cells to begin a 15s countdown to victory!
[*]If both teams have 10 Fuel Cells or are tied in fuel cells, the 15s countdown will be held until a team is able to capture and hold just one more fuel cell (and thus the pressure begins!)
[*]2 Fuel Cells are dispensed by the central Fuel Emitter immediately upon match start with each additional Fuel Cell dispensed every 8s up to a maximum of 25 Fuel Cells in play (if matches last that long!)
[*]Fuel Frenzy game mode and maps contain NO POWERUPS (Invisibility and Double Damage are currently disabled)
[*]Spawning is now team side specific! Your team will only ever spawn on your side of the map and never too close to the Fuel Emitter
[/list]
[b]FUEL FRENZY GAME MODE EFFECTS:[/b]
[list]
[*]All-new Sound FX including "Fuel Frenzy!" game mode animation card, fuel cell dispensed, fuel cell picked up, and Red/Blue team countdown started—remember these sounds as they're all important indicators of match status and could mean the difference in a last minute victory!
[*]Keep an eye out on the Fuel Frenzy game mode specific scoreboard and keep track of your team's collected Fuel Cells! Once a team collects 10 (uncontested) Fuel Cells, your team's fuel bar blinks and the countdown begins!
[*]Any Pilot carrying a Fuel Cell gains a glowing overhead Fuel Cell icon indicating the number of held Fuel Cells—aim for high value targets!
[/list]
[b]FUEL FRENZY HINTS:[/b]
[list]
[*]The central Fuel Emitter glows brighter green the closer it gets to spawning another fuel cell. Timing is everything... even if you have to camp the only fuel cell you need
[*]Try a number of different weapons (and vantage points to shoot them from) in Fuel Frenzy... you'll be surprised at the newly effective combinations of Primary, Secondary, and Ultimates
[*]Be careful in timing your Ultimates! Try sending non-fuel cell holding teammates on an offensive Sentry drop to keep enemies away
[*]If you happen to blast away an enemy pilot carrying fuel cells away with a Havoc, their death ragdoll (or gibs?) is often an indicator of where their fuel cells will fall after the carnage
[*]It's not always necessary to go after the enemy Pilot with the most fuel cells as long as they haven't started countdown
[*]Body block like a true MVP and save a pilot's life
[/list]
[i]SBM Commentary: Welcome to Fuel Frenzy! It's been nothing less than an incredible time building this new game mode for all of you and is a culmination of our efforts tuning the game across ALL areas (revamped weapon physics, gameplay VMAX, controls, netcode... you name it). Once you step into a Fuel Frenzy arena, you'll know exactly why Update 1.5 "NEW FOUNDATIONS"  was necessary to achieve better balance across Pilot movement and weapon types'cap'--high-speed, objective-based, game modes like FF are just the start![/i]

[b]HUD UPDATES:[/b]
[list]
[*] - In-game global notifications have been moved to a newer, cleaner Kill Feed (Powerup Pick-up, Kill Streak)
[*]New Kill Streak icon! Your kill streaks appear to the left of your Ultimate meter and scale in incremenets of x2, x5, and x10
[*]'Active Bounty' icon and countdown appears to the left of your Ultimate meter
[/list]
[b]AUDIO & VISUAL FX:[/b]
[list]
[*] - In addition to all-new Fuel Frenzy effects...
[*] - Game modes now have new intro voice overs and animations: "Deathmatch" (previously Team Deathmatch) and "Fuel Frenzy"
[*] - Killing enemies with Wildfyre or Incendiary Grenades now include fire disintegration effects on death ragdoll
[*] - All-new jump pad VFX (Purple base with highlights and arrow indicators)
[*] - Smoother weapon guidelines (less jagged) for all curved or thrown projectiles
[*] - Spectator Audio has been re-tuned on all maps and zoom levels with the addition of Fuel Frenzy
[*] - Spectator VFX now match team colors (including projectile trails, Sentries and Drones)
[/list]
[i]SBM Commentary: Fuel Frenzy was just too cool not to revamp our existing animations so we've created completely new game mode animations that make VERY CLEAR what game mode you're about to step foot in. On top of that, a very subtle (maybe not so subtle?) flame-death disintegration animation highlights that deaths in the future can be specific for certain weapons ;). Lastly, we've watched and supported MANY of our community tournaments and there are many improvements to do for spectator mode to make the viewing experience better but for now we're tuning spec-audio again and have finally 'sided' the deployable sentries and drones. We're still looking VERY closely at what commentators and spectators have given us feedback on, so don't worry... much more to come here too![/i]

[b]QUALITY OF LIFE:[/b]
[list]
[*]Socket Disconnect/Reconnect V1 is now available for Pilots that switch between Wi-Fi and Cellular OR drop due to a connectivity speedbump for up to 20s (same platform only... for now).
[*]Failure to vote during intermission lobbies in Public queue matches automatically default to the last played Game Mode (and the first map on the top of the list)
[*]'Fixed' controls are truly, really, fixed!
[/list]
[b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]
[list]
[*]THUNDERSTORM's true range now matches it's VFX—our apologies to the Zeus' of the skies!
[*]Fuel Frenzy game mode does NOT spawn any Double Damage or Invisibility Power Ups!
[/list]
[b]OVERALL IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]
[list]
[*]More netcode tweaks and improvements to lag compensation and hit markers being even more 'confirmed'
[/list]
[b]WHAT'S IN THE FUTURE:[/b]
[list]
[*]'3D' Maps, Improved Map Geometry, and more "Pixelwalking" fixes
[*]Player Camera Improvements
[*]Party Systems, Clan Improvements, Matchmaking V2, Progression V2, Economy V3 and much, much more!
[*]We're keeping an eye on: iPad Controls and various 4:3 aspect ratio related bugs, Customizable HUD,
[*]gear.armajet.com—get your own personalized Armajet gear now + female tees are in!
[*]Join our official Discord community for even more info, official dev stream times, and upcoming features! 
[/list]
[i]SBM Commentary: Building Fuel Frenzy had to be the LOUDEST in-office experience in 'playtesting' together we've ever had at Super Bit Machine (can you imagine?) Take a close look at what's ahead and what can only improve the game mode playlist experience in the future. Update 1.7 will be huge and we'll do our best to drop hints along the way! 

Enjoy Fuel Frenzy, Pilots![/i]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.5.X RELEASE NOTES **NEW FOUNDATIONS (PART I)**
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33631841/66a02fbf1b630c795e038d4163deb677408a1570.jpg[/img]

[i]Greetings fellow Pilots![/i]

We're calling Update 1.5 Part I (of II) of the 'New Foundations' patches coming up that will now define our new core in-game experience. First, we focused squarely on specific speeds relative to Pilot and Projectile velocities (and generally Maximum Velocity values or 'VMAX'). Secondly, we upgraded everything about VFX and Audio FX to pair with better Pilot and Team clarity in the arena (and these changes are critically important for the new game modes incoming...). Finally, with more on-screen feedback available plus a broken out boost mechanic, the in-game HUD and mobile controls have been remapped to be futureproof (more below).

[i]To our community:

This WILL be an entirely different ARMAJET experience going forward and the only way to understand 'why' is to jump in and fight. Keep in mind that we'll always strive to give you, our users, the best and most fair in-game experience round after round (and we've even studied and taken into account many of the amazing cross-regional tournament events you've all produced). For instance, many of the core flight mechanics have been retained (like chain bunnyhopping) but now just achieved a bit differently. Through more and more testing sessions leading to 1.5, two statements should now be true: 1) if you've learned how to FLY and position yourself well, you'll be a more dangerous Pilot. 2) If you're joining us for the first time, making you a dangerous Pilot and an asset to your team will take LESS time. Shall we go through some beefy release notes?[/i]

[h1]Update 1.5.X Official Release Notes[/h1]
[i]Please read these thoroughly, including the KNOWN-ISSUES which will be updated ASAP.[/i]

[b]MAJOR HUD & CONTROLS UPGRADES[/b]

Mobile:
[list]
[*] Refreshed minimal HUD to focus you on the action! New Kill Log, Kill Streak, Medal Animations, Primary/Secondary/Ultimate Fire Buttons (all platforms) and the introduction of...
[*] Much anticipated Boost button is now available on all mobile devices for increased button parity cross-platform–the "OG" Tap-Swipe mechanic is retained for veteran pilots making the transition.
[*] Movement directional indicator has been added to Pilot models
[*] Targeting an enemy brings up a targeting reticle (tied to Auto-Aim... but don't rely on it to finish the job!)
[/list]
PC:
[list]
[*] Remapped buttons and joystick 'dead zone' tweaks for increased responsiveness for XBOX and PS4 controllers–see in-game Settings > Controls! 
[*] Pressing the 'Escape' key brings up in-game Settings menu and Holding 'Tab' brings up quick scoreboards.
[/list]
SBM Commentary: [i]The Mobile Boost Button has arrived! We're excited to bring button parity even closer to all platforms with the main goal to eventually bring customizable HUD to mobile. The breakout placement of the mobile boost button on the right of HUD won't be perfect for everyone and we know you'll want to have more options, but in general was the most ideal placement for the average user. Also, mobile users have the ability to fire-cancel secondaries by dragging the secondary button back to its origin--we have a solution in mind for PC users that we're working on as well. And PC users with an XBOX or PS4 controller, give us a whirl and let us know what you think![/i]

[b]CROSS-PLATFORM AUDIO & VISUAL FX UPGRADES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Team Visual FX have been completely revamped for clarity–Easily recognize friends and foes with new team color Weapon Trails, Shields, and Health Bars!
[*] Primary, Secondary, Boost, and Ultimate now have an audio effect upon recharge to remind Pilots they're available to use again.
[*] All Primaries and Secondaries now display an aim 'cone' or 'line' of accuracy (replacing the laser sight) that also double as status indicators of fire (grey means you've got ammo and red means you're on cooldown).
[*] Medals, Boost, Weapon Cooldowns, Ultimates have all-new spicy audio FX!
[*] Frags, explosions and smoke trails have been upgraded along with projectile surface impact marks.
[*] Grenades now blink when they're 'live'... BOOM!
[*] Match start/end 5s countdown timer sequence 'tick' implemented–more match suspense!
[*] "Screen Shake" FX scale with explosive force
[*] Shields/Super Shield have been visually updated to be spherical and reflect the direction of incoming damage!
[*] Shields are now 'shattered' upon breaking or taking over-damage... serving as a visual warning to you and your enemies 
[*] The infamous Jetpack Death scream makes a comeback to all Pilots!
[/list]
[i]SBM Commentary:

We went clean and as minimal as possible for all the static on-screen HUD elements (especially for mobile) presented to a Pilot in-game. With so much new visual information coming at you, your focus should always be on the battle and thus Buttons, Medals, Streaks, and even the Kill Log have been updated and or displaced to much better HUD areas. Gentle audio reminders now exist for Primary, Secondary, Boost, and Ultimate 'ready' sounds and having these be 'second nature' going forward can only help if you choose to turn off the HUD for a more immersive experience. Lastly, all weapon trails, shields, and health bars are indicative of friendly or enemy team origin--heed these visual cues which will only help you determine where and what is coming at you.[/i]

[b]MAJOR GAMEPLAY & WEAPON BALANCE CHANGES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Pilot movement mechanics have been finer-tuned; the VMAX cap has been slightly reduced but the new boost mechanic gets you to VMAX faster (important for advanced movement)
[*] On the ground Pilot run speed has been slightly increased
[*] Secondaries can now be cooked indefinitely! Scare your enemies as you plan your grenade throws with ease!
[*] In-air horizontal movement speed has been slightly increased
[*] The "Red = Dead" HUD damage has been removed and replaced with a blinking Pilot Health bar in near-death 
[*] Boosting is now available every 3s in an independent tank and Pilots can reach VMAX quicker by utilizing Boost efficiently--Boosting is also now available downward!
[*] Projectile velocities in general have been reduced to improve Pilot reactivity, readability, and weapon balancing across the board–this MAJOR gameplay update has helped us improve hit registration, player registration, lag compensation overall and off-screen kills (especially across regions)
[*] Jetpacks in general have received a buff (more fuel since Boost isn't shared in a single tank)
[*] Ultimates charge ~3x faster and are normalized to every Ultimate–we're OPEN to more feedback ranking each Ultimate's charge time by their importance!
[*] Self-damage has been removed for certain weapon types (Wildfyre, Venom, Airstrike Napalm flames)
[*] Jetpack death is triggered only outside a 2m pilot-to-pilot radius and if in open skies (over a 5m+ ceiling) and inflicts 90 damage on impact
[*] Shield + Super Shield Ultimate now stacks for a maximum of 250HP–normal Shield is depleted first during damage.
[*] Weapon Mechanics Changes (Ripper, Lycan, Dominion, Havoc, Nightfall)
[/list]
[i]SBM Commentary:

Two easy words describe the above: META CHANGE. But know that each game you'll play you'll begin to notice some of the most important improvements in the game: Shots will register better (especially across regions), Pilot glitches will occur less (or not at all), flying and dodging (and juking) will result in new flight styles, and more weapons in the Armory will see use in the skies. Skilled Pilots will take advantage of these new flight mechanics which will result in more advanced fights. Remember: the better Pilot in a dogfight will extract every ounce of fuel/boost and movement to claim victories.

All weapons have taken a velocity hit (~10-45%) and we know this will take some adjustment time--we believe this indirectly raises the skill cap with the game being now played differently and with projectile predictions in mind (especially when fighting across surfaces). Plus, even though VMAX has been slightly lowered for Pilots, we've increased the possibility of staying in this "VMAX Zone" much more so take advantage of gravity and momentum![/i]

[b]RIPPER, LYCAN, DOMINION, HAVOC, NIGHTFALL, DRONES... OH MY![/b]
[list]
[*] Ripper now shoots 3 saw blades at 35dmg each and also has been adjusted for a more horizontal shot (similar to the Widowblade arc).
[*] Lycan and Dominion shotguns are now MUCH more dangerous with a tighter bullet spread and slightly more range.
[*] Have fun with the Lycan as a true automatic breaching shotgun (great for defense and laying down quick covering AOE fire). Each pump now deals 48dmg up close (or 4x12dmg).
[*] Dominion is the superman-dive shotgun you've always wanted, with the same 100dmg out (or 4x25dmg) in a tighter spread–another possible one-shot weapon to counter range.
[*] Havoc rocket launcher now has an acceleration modifier and gradually increases in velocity as it travels to maximum range–this makes the weapon slightly more advanced to use this build (especially as it retains a massive 90dmg direct hit)
[*] Thunderstorm "nerfed" (but not really) to 7dmg per tick but retained shot interval speed (try it out, naysayers!)
[*] The dreaded Nightfall has been reverted to its original, incredibly dangerous, form. We'd like to observe what happens with its usage, especially with the weapon VMAX changes.
[*] Flame drones were pretty spicy... damage down to 8 per tick (along with Wildfyre, retaining additional burn damage).
[*] Lightning drones were too tickly... damage down to 7 per tick (matching Thunderstorm shot interval speed)
[*] Quantum "buffed" to 14dmg per shot and 16 clip size (pew pew pew is back and balanced!)
[*] Typhoon "buffed" to 11dmg per shot and a 20 clip size (take advantage of its light weight and get up close and personal... or else)
[*] Locust "buffed" to 14dmg per shot and 20 clip size (take advantage of its light weight and knockback potential)
[*] Wildfyre, Venom & Flames (Airstrike Napalm) self-damage have been removed to ease team readability... let's keep an eye out on these weapons/characteristics together.
[*] Sniper weapon VMAXes in general are now tuned to their correct effective range: Medium to Long Range–really. Seriously.
[/list]
[b]OVERALL FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS [/b]
[list]
[*] Reminders to register for Super Bit ID have been implemented–keep your account synchronized across ALL devices. Please!
[*] Canada/AUS Players - Please rate us on the App Store!
[*] Quickly "Add Friends" during intermission lobbies by tapping Pilots!
[*] 'Cancel' button is now available when pressing PLAY--no more infinite queues!
[*] Increased server stability (eliminated more room/memory leaking issues)
[*] Real-time notifications added and improved in-game (Game invites, Friend invites)
[*] Scoreboards are back after end of round in public games!
[*] Weapon stats displayed in the Armory are now dynamic!
[*] Drone and Sentry IQs raised
[*] Various bug fixes including chat fixes, UI fixes, Pilot/Weapon mismatched mod fixes, map-centering and more!
[*] Maps and Power-up optimizations
[/list]
[b]WHAT'S IN THE FUTURE[/b]
[list]
[*] More Maps, Game Modes, Squads, Clan "things", Chat and even more Pilot Skins coming up!
[*] Global economy and Store revamps!
[*] gear.armajet.com—get your own personalized Armajet gear now + female tees are in!
[*] Join our official Discord community for even more info, official dev stream times, and upcoming features!
[/list]
-----

[i]Annnnnnd lastly, just another note on VMAX changes in general–these changes help bring more fair gameplay to the arena to ALL users especially across regions. 'Ghost' Pilots, off-screen kills, and projectiles around corners will be dramatically less and hit-reg much more improved overall AND in environments where latency matters. We know you all want more fair custom games tournaments and many of these improvements will bring much needed quality of life to you, our incredible community! Consider this patch to be ~90% of the way there towards the gameplay standard we all want. All weapon balance adjustments here on out will be easier to communicate going forward as we observe global weapon use, too!

Have fun with Update 1.5 and we'll see in the skies![/i]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.4.X ** INTRODUCING NEW GAMEPLAY CHANGES & STABILITY! **
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33631841/a169ef8b9039267362b64cf1861839d86e2d828c.jpg[/img]

[i]Greetings, Pilots![/i]

Welcome to the first BIG patch of the New Year! Update 1.4.X+ introduces MAJOR gameplay changes and serves as the foundation for building a more stable, efficient, and consistent ARMAJET experience for our users. While we're proud that Update 1.3.X introduced incredible Pilot customization, big (relative to what you know as 'current') Progression system updates, and a first-look at the First Time User Tutorial... it had also introduced bugs and stability issue side-effects that were very much unwanted. Before we continue...

[i]To our community: As a side note, we weren't proud of the many issues that plagued 1.3.X and it was an even harder choice to delay a more stable patch. Most of you are familiar with our VERY fast release cadence of 'every 2 weeks' or so... but 1.3.X was a not-so-gentle reminder that quality of life for ours users must remain the most important goal. Nonetheless, our incredible community of Pilots continued to fly fearlessly into our skies! For this we have no other words but 'THANK YOU' for the amazing patience and understanding as we create the game you've always been looking for. We've been humbled by your support and positivity, especially as we see more and more of you everyday![/i]

[h1]Update 1.4 Official Release Notes[/h1]
[i]Please read these thoroughly, including the KNOWN-ISSUES (there are just a few that we'll be hotfixing ASAP).[/i]

[b]OVERALL CROSS-PLATFORM GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] More responsive shooting and hit registration
[*] Eliminated the "Valor Sniping" exploit when joining an active lobby—upon joining a match in progress, a 60s 'JOIN' countdown begins!
[*] All players are now able to shoot-through friendlies for maximum damage and reduced fear of self-inflicted grenade deaths (beware... it is STILL a generally BAD idea to clump together!)
[*] Infamous 'dumb' AI/Bots have been revisited with an IQ boost (more improvements to come)
[*] Enjoy quicker TDM matches with 3:00 minute maximum time limits and 30 maximum kill limit!
[*] Audio 'Health' filter has now been applied to warn you of certain death; scaling as a player takes damage (blunt realism with bigger damage!)
[*] Auto-aim 'snap' on mobile is improved with better tracking on mobile-devices; accuracy lessens with player movement (not a substitute for actually aiming properly!)
[*] Mouse cursor is now confined to the specific gameplay screen.
[/list]
[i]Super Bit Machine: We hate killing ourselves with our own frag grenades just as much you do! Consequently we've also heard your general feedback revolving around "Why would I want to aim for my friend intentionally in any firefight?" and we agree that 'shooting through' can makes sense...so we're giving it a go! This gameplay design overhaul also led to quicker matches in general so maximum time limits and kill caps were lowered to also supplement and reflect quicker matchmaking with more human lobbies. As an added realism feature, an audio-cue for 'how dead' you are has also been added--this scales in damage... try taking a rocket to the face just once![/i]

[b]FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS FOR OVERALL STABILITY[/b]
[list]
[*] Hotfix: Immersion Mode:ON/OFF in either state no longer interrupts end of round or causes 'Scoreboard Stuck' issue!
[*] Hotfix: Improved loadout updating between matches in custom games
[*] Hotfix: Gold now visually updates when users complete Challenges in Player Profile
[*] Hotfix: Fixed the infamous 'Stuck Secondary' bug in Public and Custom games
[*] Dark maps, missing pilots, missing weapons, and other missing asset issues fixed with streamlined asset downloading – including more prompts for data usage and stability during the loading processes.
[*] Fixed multiple visual glitches related to menus, improving scene transitions, text fields, loading icons, clans and overall UI elements affected.
[*] New and improved menu background for performance and consistency across Home, Bounty Open, New Weapon and Armory screens!
[*] Stability: Fixed multiple memory leaks in menus which also fixed multiple crashing issues on lower-end devices.
[*] Various back-end bug fixes and server improvements
[*] Tutorial: First time user experience given a "crash-cleansing" with removal of multiple non-responsive and halting issues, including device sleep and external notification breakers.
[*] Updated HR Pilot poses and removed Ana Pilot "T-posing" bugs.
[*] Matchmaker improved to reduce wait times and improved lobby merging for more human matches!
[*] Split-screening has been disabled for all mobile devices (formerly resulted in shifting UI elements; resulting in non-responsive app states).
[*] Netcode: 100% Hit-registration is now confirmed by the servers and relayed back to client upon successful hit with the damage number indicator (when in doubt, always trust the numerical damage).
[*] Netcode: Servers have been beefed up for load balancing; continually being tuned for smoother connections and matchmaking per region.
[*] Spectator Mode: Audio adjusted per map for spatial audio when spectating with scaling zoom levels.
[/list]
[i]Super Bit Machine: Echoing our introduction, we've owed better STABILITY to our players for nearly 1.5 months. Please enjoy a more consistent and stable Armajet experience as we continue to stack more features into the game. There's a reason we're taking a huge stance on stability this update, especially as new maps, game modes and PARTY SYSTEM are on the way![/i]

[b]UPDATE 1.4 CURRENT KNOWN ISSUES[/b]
[list]
[*] Completing a challenge doesn't result in a VISUAL gold reward (we promise you get your hard-earned gold, it just doesn't update live yet...) STATUS: FIXED
[*] iPhone 6s PLUS devices may experience end-of-round crashes (we went ahead and ordered multiple phones to get to the bottom of this ASAP) STATUS: OPEN
[*] [Android] Armajet does not default to Full Screen on a few Samsung devices. STATUS: ACTIVELY FIXING
[*] [PC] Loadouts may not reflect weapon equip changes made in-between rounds. STATUS: FIXED
[*] [Tutorial] Parts of the tutorial map will turn pink if the user puts the app to sleep or 'backgrounds' the app while tutorial enemies are on screen (an edge case, but still). STATUS: OPEN
[*] [AI] Bots in general still need a bit more Skynet lovin' (but they're better currently) STATUS: OPEN
[/list]
[b]WHAT'S IN THE FUTURE[/b]
[list]
[*] Earn the January Top 40 Seasonal Badge—remember to land within Top 100 for Paragon Rewards!
[*] Maps, Game Modes, Update in-game HUD, Squads, and even more Pilot Skins coming up (to say the least!)
[*] MOBILE CONTROLLER SUPPORT
[*] gear.armajet.com -- get your own personalized Armajet gear now!
[*] Join our discord community for even more info, official dev stream times, and upcoming features!
[/list]
----

Enjoy Update 1.4 and PLEASE DO let us know what you think! If you missed out on the last Dev Stream where we talk about Update 1.4, catch it here. You're going to love what we'll be building on top of this patch!

[i]See you in the skies, Pilots![/i]

notes.title: CUSTOMIZE YOUR PILOT in Armory V2 - Update 1.3.X is NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ce3Q1W6PHUE][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33631841/57d6f4562222a8c97085458849c43a5c229d56a0.jpg[/img][/url]

Welcome to one of the most anticipated and all-around mega-huge, extra-chunky important updates of Armajet Early Access! Before we breakdown Update 1.3.X's release notes, we want to take a moment to thank all of the community contributions leading up to this point—your voice is heard loud and clear here at Super Moon Base and we've worked hard to accompany this update with more customization features you want (and a female Pilot finally!) and overhauls to the career progression system, bounties, directives, and store changes. With changes this big, our amazing community should have much to celebrate and discuss over the holiday season. Let's dig into the details of Update 1.3.X while you're watching the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ce3Q1W6PHUE]ARMORY V2 Official Guide[/url]!

[h1]WHATS NEW IN 1.3.4 (iOS) and 1.3.5 (Android/Steam)[/h1]

[b]CROSS-PLATFORM FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] The all-new ARMORY V2 has arrived! Introducing our starting lineup of Pilots: Kruger, Ana, and 1337—customize and explore your Pilot's available flightsuits, skin mods, and jet trails and show off in every victory!
[*] Weapon galleries within ARMORY V2 have been updated! Check out the new Weapon info and progression indicators and scroll through your available weapon gallery when selecting weapons and Ultimates for your loadout.
[*] Seasonal Leaderboard rewards are now available for the Top 100 Pilots! Get Paragon after every season: 2000 Paragon for 1st Place, 1000 Paragon for 2nd Place, 500 Paragon for 3rd Place and 250 Paragon for the rest of Top 100!
[*] Addressed various gameplay and netcode related bugs (ONGOING PROCESS)
[/list]
[b]THE BIG PROGRESSION AND STORE UPDATE[/b]
[list]
[*] Attention ALL Pilots! We've listened to your feedback and have carefully tuned the progression system including Bounty Timers, Directive Timers, and most importantly Pilot Level-to-Weapon Requirements—all of these have been significantly lowered in requirements in order to maximize weapon variation for our community, especially for Team Deathmatch mode, upcoming tournaments, and general content creator usage. Access more weapons quicker and show us what you and your teams do with them!
[*] Dynamic Store prices have been adjusted and 'Bundles' are now available for unlocking and crafting more weapon mods!
[*] Pilots, Flightsuits, and Jet Trails are now available for purchase through ARMORY V2!
[/list]
[b]NEW USER TUTORIAL AVAILABLE[/b]
[list]
[*] All new recruits will be presented with an Armajet Flight Controls, Weapon Use, Ultimate Activation and Bounty Unlocking tutorial! (This step is skipped for our Armajet veterans, but you'll be able to check it out by logging out of your Super Bit ID!)
[*] WHAT'S IN THE FUTURE
[*] Holiday sweets and stocking stuffers could be on the way...
[*] Stay tuned for the Armajet "12 Days of Christmas" Streamer rewards special event!
[*] Maps and game mode options coming up!
[*] Armajet merchandise... are you ready, Pilot?
[/list]
[i]Dev Notes: Armory V2 is an incredible milestone for all of us as it sets up the foundation of future Pilot and Weapon customization options in all future Armajet releases. You can almost imagine where more UI/Menu items could slot in within the Pilot-Armory submenu. We also love the more streamlined option to scroll through your selected Weapons and any unlocked mods upfront (with a bonus added benefit of optimizing the menus with less 3D assets). We also welcome our first female flightsuit AND A.I. flightsuit for more Pilot options. And jet trail customization... we really can't stop talking about the excitement of ARMORY V2...maybe just watch the Armory V2 guide for more! :).

Massive changes to the progression system have started, especially with Pilot-to-Weapon level requirements (newer users will observe that the Nightfall is now unlocked at Pilot Level 73 which means any Veteran Pilot since Day 1 of Early Access may find themselves close to unlocking the most advanced weapon in the game). Directive timers have been significantly reduced (halved to be exact) and Bounty timers are down to 1hr each! Needless to say, many of these changes are to completely improve your pilot progression experience in unlocking weaponry (and seeing more of these weapons in the arenas in general). Fair warning: these changes do not change the pre-requirements of actually obtaining kills to progress! Skill2Win always!

Lastly, each and every end of season now rewards our [url=https://t.co/yd9AOjca4s]Top 100 pilots with Paragon[/url]! While we develop a beefier rewards system, this was icing on the cake to release with an update this big. Let us know what you think of Update 1.3.X and thank you for your continued support of Armajet!

We'll see you in the skies, Pilot!
-Super Bit Machine[/i]
